### Task ID

WI-1842

### Goal

Clients retry `POST /orders` when a network timeout hides the first response, and the API creates a second order. Make retries safe without changing behavior for requests that carry no idempotency key.

### Authoritative sources

docs/architecture.md
docs/adr/007-durable-idempotency.md

### Allowed scope

src/**
tests/**
migrations/**

### Prohibited scope

src/api/**
src/auth/**
public API response fields
authentication and authorization
deployment configuration

### Constraints

no new dependencies
no workflow or Actions changes without human approval
no schema change beyond an additive migration
no raw idempotency keys or request payloads in storage or logs

### Non-goals

authentication and authorization changes
deployment platform changes
public response shape changes

### Validation expectations

npm run validate
PostgreSQL acceptance tests across two service instances
dependency, secret, CodeQL, scope, merge, and human-review gates

### Rollout expectations

merge only through a protected pull request after required evidence and review
no production deployment is part of this task
revert the implementation commit if acceptance evidence regresses

### Outputs

plan | A structured plan in the pull request description
changeset | A bounded changeset on an agent branch, inside the allowed scope
evidence | Links to workflow runs and uploaded artifacts

### Success criteria

AC1 | Same key and payload within 24 hours returns the original order | replays the original response across instances
AC2 | Same key with a different payload returns 409 | rejects a different payload for the same key
AC3 | Concurrent retries create exactly one order | creates exactly one order under concurrent cross-instance retries
AC4 | Requests without a key preserve current behavior | preserves baseline behavior without an idempotency key
AC5 | Raw keys and payloads are not logged | stores only fixed-length hashes
AC6 | Replays and conflicts emit metrics | emits replay and conflict metrics

### Stop conditions

a new dependency is required
a workflow, permission, or Actions change is required
a public response field would change
a schema change beyond an additive migration is required
the same required check fails twice with the same failure signature
